Name: Pekahiah, King of Israel
Summary: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, reigned two years and did evil, and was slain in the palace at Samaria by his captain Pekah, with Argob and Arieh.
KeyStory: Pekahiah slain by his captain Pekah.
RelatedPeople: Menahem, King of Israel; Pekah, King of Israel; Argob, Officer of Pekahiah; Arieh, Officer of Pekahiah
LifeLesson: The palace guard that crowns a king can unmake him just as fast.
